senses.gloss: शुद्ध pure, unmixed; the term is used (1) in connection with a vowel which is not nasalized ( अनुनासिक); cf. भाव्यमानेन सवर्णानां ग्रहणं नेतेि शुद्धो- यमुच्चार्यते, Kas. on P. VII.1.85; as also, (2) in connection with words which are used in their primary sense and not in any secondary sense: cf. शुद्धानां पठितानां संज्ञा कर्तव्या ; संज्ञोपसर्जनीभूतानि न सर्वादीनि M.Bh. on P.I.1.27 Vart. 3.
शुद्धाशुबोधसूत्रार्थव्याकरण a gloss on the Asubodha-grammar, written by a grammarian named Ramesvara.
